name: Zhejiang Taimei Medical Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Taimei Medical Technology Co., Ltd. provides digital solutions for life sciences research, development, and commercialization in Mainland China and internationally. The company offers Wiz.AI, an AI platform for clinical trials; TrialOS pharmaceutical R&D collaboration platform; PharmaOS, a pharmaceutical digital marketing platform; and the enterprise-medical academic interaction platform.
